worked_solution:
First, we organize the system so that it is in the correct order and both $x$ and $y$ appear in each equation:

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}-2x+y=9 \\ 0x-5y=-15\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we can write the system in the form $Ax=b,$ where

$$
A=[\begin{aligned}-2 & 1 \\ 0 & -5\end{aligned}]
$$

is the coefficient matrix,

$$
b=[\begin{aligned}9 \\ -15\end{aligned}]
$$

is the column vector of constants, and

$$
x=[\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}]
$$

is the column vector of variables.

So, the equation $Ax=b$ becomes

$$
[\begin{aligned}-2 & 1 \\ 0 & -5\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}9 \\ -15\end{aligned}].
$$
